messages:
eli (eng-security): folks — planning Q3/Q4 security roadmap. we have multiple customer asks (BYOK/KMS, long audit log windows, per-tenant retention) and SOC2 recert coming up. need to agree scope + launch criteria for MVP vs v1. thoughts?

maya (product): +1. propose phased approach: MVP = SOC2 controls + default audit logs (90d) + clear SLA. v1 = BYOK/KMS support (customer-managed keys) + retention UI. v2 = HSM + per-tenant legal retention windows + archive store. keeps ship small.

tess (customer-success): enterprise pilots are pushing BYOK + 1yr logs. two PoCs mentioned regulatory reqs (financial + healthcare). if we delay BYOK, we risk losing 2 deals.

dave (infra): storage/cost reality: 1yr logs x 100TB/day is huge. need tiered archival + retention lifecycle to blob storage (cheaper). MVP 90d default is fine; for longer retention we should support cold archive with async restore. also need query performance SLIs for audit investigations.

sam (legal): retention options must map to contract terms + data deletion process. for BYOK we need KMS SLA and key custody docs. also define lawful request handling and export controls in spec.

eli (eng-security): proposed launch criteria for MVP (short):
```
- SOC2: controls for access, change mgmt, logging verified by internal audit
- Audit logs: ingest, immutable append-only store, retention set to 90d by default
- Recovery: export tool for customer requests, documented runbook
- Performance: 95th pct token latency under target for owner workflows
- Legal sign-off on retention + deletion flow
```
are these acceptable as "MVP"?

maya (product): yes. add acceptance: sample customer audit (one pilot) signs off on audit log schema and retention behavior. link to OKR: security/compliance OKR Q3: reduce enterprise churn by 5% via compliance improvements.

dave (infra): to scope effort need rough estimates: storage delta, indexing cost, ingestion throughput. I can produce a sizing doc but need expected retention tiers (90d, 1yr, 3yr) and expected percent of customers opting in.

tess (customer-success): from pipeline: ~20% of current trials will request >90d. put that into sizing.

sam (legal): flag: BYOK requires KMS key lifecycle doc + customer key rotation guidance. also need to include HSM option later for FIPS-level customers.

eli (eng-security): action items:
- dave: sizing + cost delta for 90d vs 1yr vs 3yr (due EOD Fri)
- maya: draft MVP product PRD with launch criteria above (first cut by Wed)
- sam: template contract wording for retention tiers & BYOK (draft by Thu)
- tess: collect list of pilot customers willing to validate audit log schema (by end of week)
- eli: create tickets and schedule 30m decision sync next Tue

deploy-bot: created ticket SEC-452: "audit-log-retention-mvp" assigned to dave, maya, sam

dave (infra): quick note — retention lifecycle will need a background job + GC window; we should lock on a default 90d to keep infra small for MVP. longer retention moves to cold storage with restore SLA 24-72h.

maya (product): ok agree. for BYOK, we scope v1 as KMS integration (customer-managed keys via envelope encryption + KMS APIs). HSM remains v2 with extra compliance docs.

eli (eng-security): decision: MVP = SOC2 controls + 90d default audit logs + audit export + legal sign-off. v1 = BYOK/KMS + retention UI + expanded SLAs. v2 = HSM + per-tenant retention + archive UX.

tess (customer-success): I'll start lining up pilots that can validate export & retention behavior.

sam (legal): will add opt-in language for extended retention and BYOK obligations.

dave (infra): I'll post sizing doc in SEC-452 and a tentative cost model.

eli (eng-security): thanks all. scheduling the decision sync now — please block Tue 10–10:30am if you can. :thumbsup:
